verification.method: scripts/verify/econ-batch16.py reads the original World Bank zips (data/raw/wdi/), not the site's generated data; then the rendered text was read by hand
verification.what: Every figure in the direct answer, indicator cards, Key facts, story, comparison figures, table, CSV, FAQ, title, description and JSON-LD, and the claim behind each sentence (records, 'since' years, rank positions, regional comparisons, start and end years of each series, and the literacy, child-mortality and forest figures quoted from other World Bank series)
verification.against: World Bank WDI bulk files and country metadata (update 11 November 2026, CC BY 4.0)
verification.result: All 3,008 automated comparisons across the five pages matched; before publishing Burkina Faso's 'one of five economies with falling prices' was corrected to the fifth-steepest fall of 12 economies, a 'why' question that the data cannot answer was reworded on the Malawi page, and Malawi's table now shows 1961, the first year of its growth series; remittance series ending in 2023 (Benin) and 2024 (Guinea, Mali, Burkina Faso) are stated on the pages

changelog.note: First version: World Bank WDI figures (update of 11 November 2026).
